title: $α$-robust utility maximization with intractable claims: A quantile optimization approach
summary: This paper studies an $α$-robust utility maximization problem where an investor faces an intractable claim -- an exogenous contingent claim with known marginal distribution but unspecified dependence structure with financial market returns. The $α$-robust criterion interpolates between worst-case ($α=0$) and best-case ($α=1$) evaluations, generalizing both extremes through a continuous ambiguity attitude parameter.
